items: Pecan halves (as many as you need to make your beautiful pattern)

steps.title: Add the sugar and syrup
steps.body: Add: **1 cup dark brown sugar**, **¾ cup light corn syrup**, **½ tsp salt**, **¼ cup melted butter** and **1 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Add the pecans
steps.body: Sprinkle in unbaked pastry shell: **2 cups chopped pecans**.

steps.title: Arrange the pecan halves
steps.body: Pour egg mixture over pecans, and arrange on top, in a beautiful pattern: pecan halves (as many as you need to make your beautiful pattern).
